title: The autopsy

causes.title: A novelty, by design
causes.text: The company built Orbitz to be talked about and expected sales to fade: “Our expected life-cycle of the product is coming true.”[^1][^4]

causes.title: People did not like drinking it
causes.text: Adult tasters gave it two stars; an AP office poll found two thumbs up among more than a dozen.[^1][^2] One panelist wrote: “I don’t like any soft drink I have to chew.”[^2]

causes.title: No money to market it
causes.text: Clearly Canadian did not advertise its niche brands, calling advertising “quite frankly, not affordable.”[^4]

causes.title: Shelf space and distribution
causes.text: The company’s filings describe independent distributors being absorbed by the big soft-drink companies and becoming less willing to carry other makers’ new-age drinks.[^6]

disclaimer: The weights are our judgment of how much each factor contributed. Reasonable readers could weigh them differently.
